name: International Military Secret Societies

125dea1c01e2fc99.h:
Knights Templar
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1119
International banking network, operated in 10+ countries, secret inner circle rituals, coordinated military operations across continents. Members in every European royal court. Suppressed simultaneously across Europe 1307-1312.

0b5cc4a66a7145f0.h:
Knights Hospitaller (Order of Malta)
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1099
Still active sovereign entity recognized by 110 countries. Issues own passports, UN observer status. Members include military/intelligence officials. Operates hospitals and diplomatic missions in 120 countries. Could theoretically coordinate internationally today.

6666abd1af6218fa.h:
Teutonic Knights
Status: Defunct (as state)
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1190
Created independent military state in Prussia and Baltic. Ruled territory from 1224-1525. Secret chapter meetings, international recruitment from German nobility. Influenced creation of modern Prussia and Germany.

cab219ef1171460c.h:
Military Masonic Lodges
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1700
Exists in virtually every country's military. International Masonic network coordinates globally. Secret rituals, degrees, passwords. Members include generals, admirals, intelligence chiefs. Cross-border recognition and coordination. Present in NATO military bases worldwide. Estimated 100,000+ military Masons globally.

9b262f0a288917e5.h:
Operation Gladio (Stay-Behind)
Status: Defunct (officially)
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1952
NATO-sponsored secret armies in Italy, Belgium, France, Germany, Spain, Greece, Turkey, Norway, Denmark, Netherlands, Luxembourg, Portugal, Austria, Sweden, Switzerland. Coordinated from NATO SHAPE headquarters. Secret weapons caches. Parallel command structure unknown to elected governments. Confirmed by Italian Parliamentary investigation 1990.

5c195423ebbe3126.h:
Society of the Cincinnati
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1783
Founded by Continental Army officers including George Washington. Hereditary membership passed to eldest sons. International chapters in USA, France, Poland. Feared as aristocratic conspiracy in early American republic. Maintains connections between military elite families across generations. Private meetings and coordination.

6550175e2288918e.h:
Comintern Military Intelligence
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1919
International communist military coordination through 4th Department. Secret cells in Chinese, Spanish, German, and other militaries. Coordinated coups and revolutions globally. International Brigade in Spanish Civil War. Infiltrated multiple national militaries. Extensively documented in Soviet archives.

ea53e8fe7e43a3a4.h:
Le Cercle (The Circle)
Status: Active
Evidence: Well-Documented
Founded: 1952
International policy coordination group. Members include NATO generals, intelligence chiefs (CIA, MI6), defense ministers, politicians from USA, UK, France, Germany, Spain, Saudi Arabia. Meets secretly twice per year. No official records. Well-documented by investigative journalists Stephen Dorril and David Teacher. Could influence NATO and international military policy.

962486cbde11cd8d.h:
Safari Club
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1976
Secret coordination between France, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Morocco, Iran (until 1979) intelligence and military. Operated outside official channels. Conducted operations CIA couldn't after Congressional restrictions. Coordinated covert operations globally including Afghanistan mujahideen support. Confirmed by declassified documents.

17cc1cd5e6e94d8b.h:
White Russian Officers' Union (ROVS)
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1924
Exiled Tsarist military officers coordinated across France, Germany, China, USA, Yugoslavia. Secret coordination against Soviet Union. Members infiltrated various militaries and intelligence services. 100,000+ members at peak. Influenced by and influenced Nazi Germany and other intelligence services.

f5f6e0c3450e8cb2.h:
International Brigades Command
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1936
Multinational volunteer military force in Spanish Civil War. 35,000 volunteers from 50+ countries. Communist-coordinated from Moscow via Comintern. Secret recruitment networks globally. Military officers from many countries. Veterans formed networks lasting decades post-war.

beb64c656dd847c1.h:
Black International (Anarchist Military)
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1872
International anarchist coordination including military veterans. Coordinated assassinations across borders in Russia, France, Italy, Spain, USA, Argentina. Secret communication networks. Killed Russian Tsar Alexander II, Italian King Umberto I, US President McKinley, others. Propaganda by deed.

bf53278e4fd6873b.h:
Order of Assassins (Nizari Ismailis)
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1090
Islamic military-religious secret society. Elaborate initiation rituals, secret ranks, Paradise legends. Political assassination as primary strategy. Network of mountain fortresses across Middle East. Influenced regional politics for 185 years. Used as mercenaries by both Crusaders and Muslims.

8032978bd81de8ef.h:
NATO Rapid Deployable Corps Network
Status: Active
Evidence: Suspected
Founded: 1992
Multinational military command structure. Officers rotate through NATO commands developing personal networks across allied militaries. Coordinate operations across national boundaries. Classified planning. Could theoretically coordinate outside official channels. Official structure enables unofficial networks. Officers from 30+ countries.

424909ecb403f97c.h:
Synarchist Movement d'Empire
Status: Defunct (allegedly)
Evidence: Contested
Founded: 1922
Alleged international technocratic conspiracy. Members included French military, industrialists, bankers. Connections to Spain, Portugal, Latin America. Alleged coordination of military coups. Vichy France connections. International business/military network. Never fully proven but extensively investigated. Documents suggest real organization.

0c0d8245f83328ce.h:
Sovereign Military Order of Saint John
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1520
International Catholic military order. Royal patronage from Spain and Sicily. Members in many countries including military officers. Diplomatic activities with some governments. Maintains military traditions and ranks. Secret higher initiations. Smaller than Order of Malta but similar structure.

d26333c096df0828.h:
Order of Saint Maurice and Lazarus
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1572
International Catholic military order. Operates in 30+ countries. Members include military officers. Diplomatic status in some countries. Secret higher initiations. Coordinates with Vatican. Smaller than Malta but maintains international presence.

fb2fb3efbf51f118.h:
International Assoc. Military Chaplains
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1925
Vatican-sponsored coordination of military chaplains globally. Operates in 100+ countries. Secret reporting to Vatican. Coordinates Catholic military officers worldwide. Private communications network. Could influence Catholic officers in many militaries internationally.

046e47ae46de5d87.h:
Five Eyes Military Coordination
Status: Active
Evidence: Well-Documented
Founded: 1946
Intelligence sharing between USA, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand. Official cooperation confirmed. Military coordination beyond official treaties. Personal networks among military elite. Secret classification levels. Alleged deeper coordination outside official channels. Officers rotate through allied commands.

75c1b1e9cf9e67b2.h:
Templar Successor Orders (Multiple)
Status: Active
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1804
Multiple organizations claiming Templar succession. Not officially recognized but internationally organized. Members include military veterans. Operate in multiple countries. Most significant: Sovereign Military Order of the Temple of Jerusalem (OSMTH). Maintain international presence and coordination.

bb64589db0bc6bab.h:
Black Hand (Unification or Death)
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1901
Serbian military officers' secret society. Secret oaths, initiation ceremonies. Plotted to unite South Slavs. Orchestrated assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand triggering WWI. Primarily regional but international impact. Influenced by and coordinated with some Russian military circles.

2467c4838fc3caf3.h:
Young Turks (Committee Union Progress)
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1889
Secret society of Ottoman military officers. Initiated 1908 revolution. Overthrew Sultan Abdul Hamid II. Led Ottoman Empire in WWI. Secret lodges with elaborate rituals. Primarily Ottoman but international connections to European revolutionary movements and Masonic lodges.

b05b5000c1bdfcdc.h:
Carbonari
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1800
Italian secret revolutionary society. Many military officers as members. Secret lodges, elaborate rituals. Influenced Italian unification. Spread to France, Spain, Portugal with international coordination. Multiple uprisings across Southern Europe. International network of revolutionary cells.

ebfee48eaebafe8b.h:
Sons of Liberty
Status: Defunct
Evidence: Confirmed
Founded: 1765
American colonial secret society with many militiamen. Secret meetings, passwords, coordination across colonies. Boston Tea Party and other resistance actions. Sparked American Revolution. Coordinated revolutionary activities across colonial boundaries. International connections to British radicals.

92aa1e5f6d616ee6.h:
Transnational Special Forces Network
Status: Active (informal)
Evidence: Suspected
Founded: 1990
Alleged informal network of elite special forces operators. Former SEAL Team Six, SAS, GSG-9, GIGN, Spetsnaz members. Private security contractor networks. Personal relationships from joint operations. Could theoretically coordinate internationally. No evidence of organized secret society but networks exist.
